info.name: Return the data for all Documents

params.name: contact_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single Contact. Use the keyword `null` to match those without a Document. The list will be filtered to include only the Document records with the matching property.

params.name: created_since
params.description: Filter Document records to those having the `created_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).

params.name: document_category_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single DocumentCategory. Use the keyword `null` to match those without a Document. The list will be filtered to include only the Document records with the matching property.

params.name: external_property_name
params.description:
Filter records to only those with the given external property(s) name set.

e.g. `?external_property_name=Name`

params.name: external_property_value
params.description:
Filter records to only those with the given external property(s) value set. Requires external property name as well.

e.g. `?external_property_name=Name&external_property_value=Value`

params.name: fields
params.description: The fields to be returned. See response samples for what fields are available. For more information see the [fields section](#section/Fields).

params.name: ids[]
params.description: Filter Document records to those having the specified unique identifiers.

params.name: include_deleted
params.description: Allow trashed Document record to be included.

params.name: limit
params.description: A limit on the number of Document records to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 200. Default: `200`.

params.name: locked
params.description: Filter Document records to those that are locked.

params.name: matter_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single Matter. Use the keyword `null` to match those without a Document. The list will be filtered to include only the Document records with the matching property.

params.name: order
params.description: Orders the Document records by the given field. Default: `id(asc)`.

params.name: page_token
params.description: A token specifying which page to return.

params.name: parent_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single Folder. Use the keyword `null` to match those without a Document. The list will be filtered to include only the Document records with the matching property.

params.name: query
params.description: Wildcard search for `name` matching the given string.

params.name: scope
params.description: Filters Document record to those being a child of the parent Folder, or a descendant of the parent Folder. Default is `children`.

params.name: show_uncompleted
params.description: Allow Document record being uploaded to be included.

params.name: updated_since
params.description: Filter Document records to those having the `updated_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).

items.docs: Update Document, move Document to another Folder, and/or restore a trashed Document.

params.name: id

items.docs:
Deleting a Document using this method will move it to the trash instead of permanently deleting it. Trashed Documents are permanently deleted after 30 days. The following errors may be returned:

- `409 Conflict`: The Document (or one of its ancestor folders) is currently being modified by another request, and cannot be trashed.
